role: secondary temporal site-template-resistant diagnostic; cannot replace or rescue the authoritative four-bay static TNC primary
delta_definition: tnc_post - tnc_pre; both node summaries must use the same three frozen q25/q50/q75 anchor neighborhoods with distinct non-overlapping pre/post cores
no_rescue: Do not drop tnc_post, baseline_frequency_post or water_body after inspection.
Do not widen the 39-45 day pre/post TNC interval after inspection.
Do not use this diagnostic to rescue a null authoritative four-bay static TNC primary.
Do not relax matched-anchor or TNC-QC requirements after future outcomes are inspected.
Do not interpret a pre/post contrast as trajectory if assay batch is perfectly confounded with sampling round.

measurement_validity_gate.method_pilot_prerequisite: Authoritative TNC-v2 response-independent method pilot must pass its frozen analytical QC before the dynamic diagnostic is eligible for ecological interpretation.
measurement_validity_gate.analytical_precision_boundary: Technical-duplicate median TNC CV <=10%, <=10% of duplicate pairs >15% CV, and all other frozen HPLC recovery/calibration criteria must pass under the authoritative method pilot.
measurement_validity_gate.assay_batch_round_boundary: Pre/post round must not be perfectly confounded with HPLC assay batch. If all pre samples and all post samples are separated by batch in a way that makes round indistinguishable from batch, classify the dynamic diagnostic non-estimable.
measurement_validity_gate.interpretation: These gates reduce the chance that spatial core heterogeneity or analytical batch error is relabeled as reserve trajectory.
